verdict.rationale: The REST API is versioned in its path (api.rollbar.com/api/1/items), but nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy for the API. The only documented support/versioning policy covers the .NET SDK's LTS release track, which is a client library rather than the API and does not transfer to this story. missing for 10: a documented API deprecation policy or timeline, explicit API versioning documentation beyond the URL path, changelog or sunset notices for API versions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The Rollbar API provides a RESTful interface to much of the data in the system.
